method_specification.network_directionality: undirected; one-way attributes are treated as walkable undirected segments for urban pedestrian and public-realm syntax analysis
method_specification.radius_mode_description: Cumulative shortest network distance along connected street segments in meters, measured between segment midpoints. Conforms to contract 08 metric radius requirement and PD-15 decision.

angular_cost.definition: Turn angle in degrees divided by 90.0 (one 90-degree right angle = 1 turn step)
angular_cost.verification: Hand-calculated synthetic fixtures (collinear=0.0 turns, 30-deg=0.3333 turns, 45-deg=0.5 turns, 90-deg=1.0 turns, 135-deg=1.5 turns) verified in tests/test_pst_fixtures.py

segmentation_and_topology.grade_separation_handling: Explicit unlinks passed to CreateSegmentMap before graph construction; grade-separated crossings (bridge/tunnel/layer mismatch) remain non-intersecting and unlinked
segmentation_and_topology.lineage_rule: Every input polyline must be completely covered by resulting segments with fail-closed coverage audit

normalization_formulas.harmonized_node_count: PST native node_count minus 1 (excluding self origin segment)
normalization_formulas.harmonized_choice: PST native choice divided by 2 (converting bidirectional pairs to undirected pair count)

method_specification.isolated_components: Segments in disconnected components with zero reachable neighbors are harmonized to NC=0, TD=0.0, choice=0.0, NAIN=0.0, NACH=0.0

boundary_effects_and_stability.local_scale_800m: Calculated on M4H context network and provincial extract; buffered beyond 800m extent

mid_scale_2000m.stability_metric: Spearman rank correlation >= 0.98 within StudyArea; segments varying >5% tagged EDGE_AFFECTED

regional_scale_10000m.provincial_boundary_clipping: Verified against zuid-holland.poly boundary; buffer regions truncated by provincial boundary tagged EDGE_AFFECTED

syntax_method_comparison_v1.disposition: Custom engine retired per PD-15; comparison failure preserved immutable; PST 3.3.1 established as authoritative method of record
